latin_text: It is a commonplace expression in the schools that man is a lesser world, in which are seen a body compounded from the elements, and a heavenly spirit, and the vegetative soul of plants, and the sense of brutes, and reason, and the angelic mind, and the likeness of God.
english_translation: It is a commonplace expression in the schools that man is a lesser world, in which are seen a body compounded from the elements, and a heavenly spirit, and the vegetative soul of plants, and the sense of brutes, and reason, and the angelic mind, and the likeness of God.
exegesis: Man as microcosm contains an angelic mind—the highest faculty of human soul participates in angelic intellection. This is key to understanding human dignity and spiritual ascent.
notes: HARVESTER passage: H.SP.5 | Human soul contains angelic intellect; man as microcosm mirrors angelic order
